import torch
import torch.nn as nn
from torch.utils.cpp_extension import load_inline

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Custom CUDA kernel for row‑wise L2 normalization (divide each element by the
# Euclidean norm of its row).  The kernel operates on a flat view of the tensor
# where the second dimension (index 1) holds the features.
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
l2norm_kernel_source = """
__global__ void l2norm_kernel(const float* a, float* out, int total_elements, int dim) {
    int idx = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
    if (idx < total_elements) {
        int row = idx / dim;
        int col = idx % dim;
        float val = a[row * dim + col];
        float norm_sq = 0.0f;
        for (int k = 0; k < dim; ++k) {
            float v = a[row * dim + k];
            norm_sq += v * v;
        }
        float norm = sqrtf((float)norm_sq);
        out[idx] = val / norm;
    }
}

torch::Tensor l2norm_cuda(torch::Tensor a) {
    auto size = a.numel();
    auto out = torch::zeros_like(a);

    const int block_size = 256;
    const int num_blocks = (size + block_size - 1) / block_size;

    l2norm_kernel<<<num_blocks, block_size>>>(
        a.data_ptr<float>(),
        out.data_ptr<float>(),
        size,
        a.size(1)
    );

    return out;
}
"""

# Declare the C++ function signature
element_l2norm_cpp_source = "torch::Tensor l2norm_cuda(torch::Tensor a);"

# Compile the inline CUDA operator
element_l2norm = load_inline(
    name="l2norm",
    cpp_sources=element_l2norm_cpp_source,
    cuda_sources=l2norm_kernel_source,
    functions=["l2norm_cuda"],
    verbose=True,
    extra_cflags=[],
    extra_ldflags=[]
)

# New model that replaces the native `torch.norm` + division with the custom CUDA operator
class ModelNew(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.l2norm = element_l2norm

    def forward(self, x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
        return self.l2norm(x)
